Name: Kegs for ADHD
Author: baseohis
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Kegs for ADHD[/b][/size]
[i]Never let an empty machine go unnoticed again.[/i][/center]
[line]
Do you struggle with object permanence in Stardew Valley? Do you constantly walk past your machines, forgetting to refill them because empty kegs just blend into the background? [b]Kegs for ADHD[/b] is here to help.
This mod highlights empty machines with a customizable brightness boost, making them "pop" out of the scenery. Once you fill them, they return to their normal appearance and animations, allowing you to focus on what actually needs your attention.
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/44580/44580-1775158063-2469543.gif[/img]﻿
[i]Left: Normal machines | Right: Highlighted empty machines[/i][/center]
[line]
[size=4][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Visual Alerts:[/b] Empty machines glow based on your preference, helping you spot idle production lines instantly.
[*] [b]Native Feel:[/b] Once a machine starts working, the mod steps aside. You'll see the original animations, bubbles, and sparkles exactly as intended.
[*] [b]Supported Machines:[/b] [b]Kegs[/b], [b]Preserves Jars[/b], and [b]Casks[/b].
[*] [b]Full Customization:[/b] Change the brightness for each machine type individually via the [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b].
[*] [b]Live Preview:[/b] See exactly how the brightness looks directly in the config menu.
[*] [b]Global Support:[/b] Fully translated into English, Portuguese, Spanish, German, and Chinese.
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/44580/44580-1775158062-486527388.gif[/img]﻿
[i]Easily adjust settings and see the preview in real-time.[/i][/center]
[line]
[size=4][b]⚙️ Requirements & Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][b]SMAPI[/b][/url].
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/url] to adjust brightness in-game.
[*] Download this mod and extract it into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.
[*] Run the game and look for the gear icon on the title screen!
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]🇧🇷 Versão em Português[/b][/size]
Você sofre com "cegueira de objeto" ou TDAH no Stardew? Esquece de colocar frutas nos barris porque eles se camuflam no cenário quando estão vazios? O [b]Kegs for ADHD[/b] resolve isso destacando as máquinas ociosas.
[list]
[*] [b]Destaque Visual:[/b] Máquinas vazias brilham; máquinas trabalhando ficam normais.
[*] [b]Preserva Animações:[/b] Não interfere nas bolhas, geleias ou tampas das máquinas em funcionamento.
[*] [b]Customizável:[/b] Ajuste o brilho de cada máquina separadamente.
[/list]
[line]
[i]Special thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community for the support and tools![/i]
